title: Signs Everywhere and Forgiving the Doubters

paragraphs.text: There are also signs in the creation of human beings and of the moving creatures that Allah spreads across the earth, for people of certain faith. The changing of night and day, the provision He sends down from the sky to bring the earth back to life after it was lifeless, and His directing of the winds are signs for people who use reason. These are Allah's verses, recited in truth; if people reject them, what will they believe?

Woe to every sinful liar who hears the verses of Allah recited to him and then continues in his pride, as if he had not heard them at all. Whenever he learns any of the verses, he mocks them, and such people face a humiliating punishment. Hell awaits them, and neither their earnings nor their chosen protectors will help. The Qur'an is true guidance, while those who reject it face a foul, painful punishment.

Allah has made the sea serve people, so that ships sail by His command and people seek His bounty and give thanks. He has made everything in the heavens and earth serve them, all as a gift from Him, and in this there are signs for those who reflect. The believers are told to forgive those who do not expect the days of Allah, since Allah will repay every people for their deeds. Whoever does good benefits himself, whoever does evil harms himself, and all will return to their Lord.

Allah gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, judgement and prophethood, provided them with good things, and preferred them over the worlds. He gave them clear proofs, yet they split only after knowledge reached them, out of envy among themselves, and Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Then He placed the Prophet on a clear way of religion, so he must follow it and not the desires of those without knowledge. Wrongdoers are allies of one another, but Allah is the protector of the righteous. This Qur'an is clear insight for mankind, and guidance and mercy for people who are certain.
